name: dev.devicecloud/dcd
description: Run Maestro mobile app tests on devicecloud.dev: submit flows, check status, download artifacts.

environmentVariables.name: DEVICE_CLOUD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your devicecloud.dev API key. Alternatively run `dcd login` once to use a stored session.

environmentVariables.name: DCD_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide the billable dcd_run_cloud_test tool (recommended for autonomous agents).

environmentVariables.name: DCD_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (e.g. for a non-production environment).
